views.markdown:
**One circular design. Three live indicators.**

DuoBar brings battery percentage, Wi‑Fi strength, and cellular signal together in a clean, compact status-bar icon for iOS 16.

views.text: Design preview · illustrative values, not an on-device screenshot

views.markdown:
- Battery percentage with an open circular charge ring
- Wi‑Fi indicator in the center and four cellular dots
- Light and dark status-bar appearances
- Special colors for low battery, charging, and Low Power Mode
- **Settings → DuoBar → Enable DuoBar** to turn it on or restore the original icons
- Control Center battery percentage and rotation-lock overlap fixes
- Custom Settings icon, organized options, and direct RBx9 Repo / Sileo links
- Adjustable DuoBar Size slider from **70% to 140%** with live updates and Reset Size to 100%
- **New v0.2.6:** Transparent Settings icon and Report a Bug / Help Test Other iOS Versions email shortcuts
- Updated to the v0.2.6 codebase, including the Personal Hotspot chain-link inside the ring and Control Center layout fixes
- **v0.2.7:** Improvements and overall polish
- **v2.7.1:** Simplified version numbering; all familiar DuoBar features remain
- **v2.7.2:** No more jump when Control Center closes; DuoBar lands exactly in place
- **v2.7.2:** Compact 5G/LTE label inside the ring
- **v2.7.2:** Larger sizes stay on screen on Home-button iPhones; no stock battery flash during rotation and Control Center transitions
- **v2.7.2:** Safer loading: features switch off on their own if iOS lacks a method they need

**iOS 16.0–16.7.x with standard Rootless** (`iphoneos-arm64`, installed in `/var/jb`), on an iOS 16 build the jailbreak supports: **Dopamine** on iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, 11 series, SE (2nd and 3rd generation), 12 series, 13 series and 14 series; **palera1n** on iPhone 8, 8 Plus and X. Requires tweak injection and PreferenceLoader. **Not compatible with RootHide**; choose DuoBar (RootHide) for that.

**Not supported:** iOS 17, 18 and 26; iPhone 15 and newer.

Tested on an **iPhone 14 Pro Max with iOS 16.4.1** (stable, smooth Control Center closing) and in the iOS 16.4 simulator on the iPhone 12, 13 mini, 14, 14 Pro, 14 Pro Max and SE at 70%, 100% and 140%. Do not install both DuoBar (RootHide) and DuoBar (Rootless).
